name: David Lawrence

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Sybil, daughter of Robert Sterry.

bioAdditions: Seventh son of John, son of Joseph, son of William & Elizabeth Smith (S1): 3rd cousin 8 times removed. A Providence merchant and patriot, 'the intimate friend of Benjamin Franklin', who named a son after Samuel Adams; moved to Hudson in 1783 as one of its thirty founding proprietors and served as recorder and mayor.
funFacts: Named one of his sons after the patriot Samuel Adams.

sources.citation: Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), pp. 55-56
